text:
perfbot: nightly-perf-ci: ALERT for job `nightly-smallbatch-1024` — p99 latency up ~30% vs baseline for model redwood-2.1 (seq=1024, small-batch). link: https://dash.redwood.ai/r/bench/2460012345
Alex: ugh. spotted this in morning digest. any obvious recent infra/kernel changes?
Priya: pinging @Jin (on-call) for infra noise. also @Nora can you check the bench artifacts?
Jin (on-call): on it. I see the job landed on pool `dedicated-eu-3` at 03:12UTC. No node reboots logged, but kernel upgrades rolled to the pool last night (linux 5.19.x -> 6.0.x).
Mateo: thanks. quick hypothesis: kernel scheduler or NIC driver could affect tiny batch tail. we'll try reproducing locally on the same image.
Nora: grabbing artifacts now — flamegraphs + logs available here: https://artifacts.redwood.ai/nightly/2460012345.tar.gz
Sam: FYI the change that landed 2 days ago (PR #5412) toggled the "tiny-batch-optimizer" to enabled by default for small-batch profiles. Could be related.
Alex: good call. PR #5412 touched kernel-level affinity hints and also changed continuous-batching defaults.
Priya: can someone run the fast repro? command we use:
```bash
# run on a machine in the same pool image
./bench --model redwood-2.1 --seq 1024 --batch-mode small --batch-size 8 --iters 200 --profile --out /tmp/run2460
```
Mateo: running that now on a sandbox VM. will attach profiler shortly.
Jin (on-call): infra: I'll pin the nightly to pool dedicated-eu-2 (older kernel) for the next run to see if kernel is the factor. Leaving dedicated-eu-3 alone for investigation.
Nora: quick observation from flamegraph: increased time in `kv_cache::sync` and `scheduler::wake_wait` paths around the same p99 spikes. attaching snippet: `scheduler::wake_wait +18%`
Sam: that lines up with the affinity/hints change in #5412. Could cause more context switches on tiny batches.
Alex: plan proposal: 1) reproduce locally (Mateo/Nora). 2) run nightly pinned to older kernel (Jin). 3) try disabling tiny-batch-optimizer flag to confirm (Sam). 4) bisect PR range if confirmed.
Priya: agree. add who owns each. Mateo = reproduce + profile, Nora = artifact triage + flamegraphs, Sam = flip flag and run quick nightly, Jin = pin pool + hold capacity. I'll coordinate rollbacks if we confirm.
Mateo: repro started. initial run shows same p99 bump ~+28%. profiler output link: https://prof.redwood.ai/runs/2460012345/mateo
Nora: digging into profiler — I can repro the `kv_cache` stalls when small-batch optimizer selects different prefetching strategy.
Sam: flipping the runtime flag now to `--tiny-batch-optimizer=false` and re-running the nightly job on a quick test pool.
perfbot: test-run for job `quick-smallbatch-1024` completed: p99 returned near baseline when optimizer disabled. details: https://dash.redwood.ai/r/bench/2460012345/quick-run
Alex: excellent — that isolates it to the optimizer. next step is a bisect on PRs that touched the optimizer and affinity hints. suspect PR #5412 and #5387.
Mateo: I can bisect tomorrow morning, will scope commits between 5387..5412. ETA 4-6hrs.
Priya: if bisect pins it to #5412 we should ship a patch that reverts the affinity change and re-enable optimizer safely. Sam, can you draft a revert/patch?
Sam: on it. drafting PR now: revert-affinity-hints-rollback. will link in thread when ready.
Jin (on-call): leaving the pool pin for one more run. will hold any autoscaling/deploys to dedicated-eu-3 for ~2 hours.
Nora: note for postmortem: add a small regression test that runs small-batch profiles with optimizer toggled and asserts p99 within X% of baseline.
Alex: +1 to that. also add a guard in rollout to hold optimizer behind a runtime flag for a week after kernel upgrades.
Mateo: bisect started — first candidate commit shows failure reproduced. posting updates as I go.
Sam: PR ready in draft: https://git.redwood.ai/p/redwood/runtime/pulls/5490 — revert affinity hint. will convert to active if bisect confirms.
Priya: great. I'll prep a short incident note and add to the weekly ops sync.
Alex: thanks everyone. quick thumbs: :thumbsup:
Mateo: bisect found culprit: commit `a7d3f2` (part of #5412) — it changed `sched_hint` assignment order. Repro confirmed.
Sam: converting draft PR to active and requesting review from @Priya and @Alex.
Jin (on-call): all good on infra side, pool pin removed after we confirm new nightly with revert.
Alex: final next actions: (1) merge revert PR, (2) run two successful nightlies, (3) add guard tests and rollout policy. Owner: Sam for PR, Mateo/Nora for validation, Priya for postmortem. Closing loop when two nightlies are green.
Nora: attaching short notes for postmortem: "tiny-batch optimizer + affinity change caused context switch regressions visible at p99 for seq=1024"
Sam: merged revert PR -> build queued. will shout when green. :rocket:
perfbot: nightly-perf-ci: follow-up run shows p99 back to baseline for redwood-2.1 small-batch. job: nightly-smallbatch-1024/2460012345-2
Alex: awesome. thanks team. we'll write up a short postmortem and add the new regression test into the nightly smoke suite.
Priya: nice work everyone. :clap:
Sam: closing thread once postmortem + tests are in.
Alex: leaving a quick note — kudos to the fast isolate. :tada:
